descriptions: The final {LOCATION} opens before you. This is it.
The {THREAT} has reached its peak. Whatever happens next happens here.

commands.look: The {ANTAGONIST} is close. The {LOCATION} offers one last option. Go north.

latents.fact: a fragment of the {MACGUFFIN} has broken off and lies in the corner — still faintly active
latents.item_desc: A shard of the {MACGUFFIN}. It hums against your palm.

latents.fact: the {ANTAGONIST} has already been in this room — there is a fresh mark where they stood
the ceiling here is lower than it should be — something has been built above this room
